title: 第11章 骑扫把的少女第12章 遇邪修
slug: 加入合欢宗后师妹的鱼塘炸了
content_zh:
第11章骑扫把的少女白日打了妖猪，从穆荷那里回来后，云洛早早就睡了。
第二日她被玉简的震动吵醒，注入灵力一看是褚璃拉了个小群，里面只有她、二师姐和三师姐三个人。
褚璃：“我已经和师父说好了，今早我们不用修炼，去山下买些东西，晚上和大师姐好好聚聚。”
苏羡鱼：“两刻钟后山门集合。”
云洛赶紧回了消息：“山门见。”
收好玉简，她一个鲤鱼打挺起床，换上一身绣着仙鹤的浅紫色广袖长裙。
再从乾坤袋里拿出一把梳子状的法器往头上一梳，一个素雅的灵蛇髻瞬间成型。
这是苏羡鱼炼的灵器，可以记忆修士梳过的发髻，下一次再用只需轻轻一梳就能完美复刻。
云洛愿称它为三师姐最有用的发明。
“拽拽。”
云洛唤了声，正在院中捉蝴蝶的拽拽转头向她跑来。
“主人。”
到了跟前，拽拽来了个脸刹，老虎般大小的身躯乖巧蹲坐在地，两只胖乎乎的爪子并拢，毛茸茸的尾巴在身后甩来甩去，将地面的花瓣扫开成一个扇形。
三年来，丹药和灵草不要钱似的投喂，拽拽不仅体型变大了，还能口吐人语。
“我今日要下山，我们一起吧。”
“好耶好耶。”
拽拽在地上打了个滚，翘屁嫩猫伸懒腰，接着趴在地上。
云洛跨坐上去，抓住它颈上长毛。
“拽拽，我们走。”
……

“云师姐。”
“今日要下山吗？”
“我能摸摸拽拽吗？”
下了灵犀峰，正赶去晨练的弟子纷纷和云洛打招呼。
在宗门，弟子们不是骑仙鹤就是御物飞行，她是唯一一个骑兔狲的，辨识度极高。
“对，下山买些东西……下次找你玩儿……你摸吧，它很乖的……我先走了。”
云洛热情回应她们，又让几个关系不错的内门弟子在拽拽胖乎乎的脑袋上摸了几把，才终于赶到山门口。
没办法，姐姐们太热情了。
拽拽跑到山门的时候，褚璃和苏羡鱼刚好到。
云洛还不会御剑飞行，三人一兽坐灵舟是最好的选择。
可苏羡鱼不是安分的主，闹着要试试她新炼的法器。
“看好了，当当当当！”
一支扫把横空出现在三人面前。
content_en:
Chapter 11 The girl riding a broomstick beat the demon pig during the day. After returning from Mu He, Yunluo went to bed early.
The next day, she was awakened by the vibration of the jade slip. When she injected her spiritual power, she saw that Chu Li had gathered a small group, and there were only three people in it: her, the second senior sister, and the third senior sister.
Chu Li: "I have already agreed with Master that we don't need to practice this morning. We will go down the mountain to buy some things and have a good time with Senior Sister in the evening."
Su Xianyu: "We will meet at the mountain gate in two quarters of an hour."
Yunluo quickly replied: "See you at the mountain gate."
After putting the jade slips away, she stood up and put on a light purple long skirt with wide sleeves embroidered with cranes.
Then he took out a comb-like magic weapon from the Qiankun bag and combed it on his head, and an elegant snake bun was instantly formed.
This is Su Xian Yulian's spiritual weapon. It can remember the bun that the monk has combed, so that it can be perfectly reproduced with just one comb the next time.
Yun Luo would like to call it Third Senior Sister's most useful invention.
"Tug."
Yun Luo called out, and Zaila, who was catching butterflies in the courtyard, turned and ran towards her.
"Master."
When he arrived, he was pulled to the face, and the tiger-sized body squatted on the ground obediently, with two chubby paws close together, and the furry tail swung behind him, sweeping the petals on the ground into a fan shape.
In the past three years, pills and spiritual herbs have been fed to her for free. Not only has her body grown bigger, but she can also speak human language.
"I'm going down the mountain today, let's go together."
"Yeah, yeah, yeah."
Tutu rolled on the ground, stretched out, and then lay down on the ground.
Yunluo sat on it and grabbed the long hair on its neck.
"Zhaolu, let's go."
…
"Sister Yun."
"Are you going down the mountain today?"
"Can I touch and tug?"
After getting off Lingxi Peak, the disciples who were rushing to do morning exercises greeted Yun Luo one after another.
In the sect, all the disciples are either riding cranes or flying objects. She is the only one who rides a rabbit and is highly recognizable.
"Yes, let's go down the mountain to buy some things...I'll play with you next time...you can touch it, it's very well-behaved...I'll leave first."
Yun Luo responded to them enthusiastically, and asked a few inner disciples with good connections to rub his chubby head a few times before finally arriving at the mountain gate.
I can't help it, the sisters are too enthusiastic.
When he ran to the mountain gate, Chu Li and Su Xianyu just arrived.
Yunluo can't fly with a sword yet, so riding a spirit boat with three people and one beast is the best option.
But Su Xianyu was not a calm master and wanted to try her newly refined magic weapon.
"Watch it, Dang Dang Dang Dang!"
A broom appeared in front of the three people.
